target.title: fix(plugins): model picker stalls on an unresponsive provider plugin
target.body:
<details>
<summary>Additional instructions</summary>

**MUST:** Keep **Allow edits from maintainers** enabled for this PR so maintainers
can help update the branch when needed.

</details>

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where the model-selection picker could wait indefinitely when an
installed provider plugin never resolved its catalog augmentation hook. Models
from healthy plugins later in discovery order could not be offered, leaving the
picker stuck instead of reaching its existing static or manual fallbacks.

## Why This Change Was Made

Catalog discovery now has distinct exact and degraded paths. The existing exact
path remains sequential and has no deadline. A separate internal degraded path
starts provider hooks together with an independent 15-second bound, then consumes
their outcomes in plugin order. It logs one sanitized diagnostic for each timed-
out invocation and continues with healthy results. Timed-out invocations are
scoped to the active registry, configuration identity, and workspace so retries
do not overlap them.

`loadModelCatalogSnapshot` remains exact by default. Only the fallback-friendly
model picker opts into degraded discovery; Gateway `models.list view=all`
explicitly stays exact. The earlier public `signal` and `timeoutMs` hook fields
were removed, so this repair does not change the provider plugin API, user
configuration, schema, wire format, or successful hook results.

## User Impact

The model picker recovers after one bounded deadline window for unresponsive
optional providers and can still show models contributed by later healthy
plugins. Exact full-catalog requests continue waiting for the complete result and
never treat omitted provider rows as a complete catalog.

## Evidence

- Production provider-runtime proof loaded two hung provider plugins followed by
  a healthy plugin. All three hooks started in the same millisecond; the degraded
  call applied one concurrent 15-second deadline window, returned
  `daily-fix-zzz-healthy/survives-timeout` in 16.243 seconds, marked the result
  non-authoritative, and emitted one sanitized diagnostic per hung plugin. A
  retry completed in 65 ms; each hung hook had still been called only once.
- The complete changed provider-runtime, model-catalog, and Gateway catalog test
  files passed: 129 tests across three repository Vitest shards (67 plugin, 56
  agent, and 6 Gateway tests). Regressions cover exact pending behavior,
  concurrent degraded deadlines with plugin-order result handling, retry
  deduplication, plugin reload, error order, degraded cache handling, and explicit
  exact mode for the full Gateway catalog.
- `pnpm build`, changed-file formatting, oxlint, import-cycle checking, and the
  dead-export check passed.
- Full test typechecking was not rerun locally because the required cgroup
  resource guard was unavailable. Remote CI remains the authoritative result for
  that lane.
- A fresh live Gateway run is not claimed: the dirty-checkout dev build produced
  transient missing `dist` chunks, and the source-entry fallback did not reach
  readiness inside the bounded proof window. The exact Gateway boundary is
  covered by the focused production-wiring regression above.
